chunks: So turn away from them for a time

key_terms.حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ: For a time / until a period

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'turn away for a time' mean in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Prophet's strategic patience (hilm) and political prudence in withdrawing from the hypocrites (munafiqun) to preserve the unity of the Muslim community. It underscores the principle of temporary disengagement as a tactical measure before decisive action, reflecting the broader theme of distinguishing between sincere believers and those who feign faith.
